subject: general
question:
Which of the following is not an input device for a computer?

A. Keyboard

B. Mouse

C. Scanner

D. Monitor
solution:
The correct answer is __**Monitor**__.

__
 
• The **monitor **is not an **input device.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Monitors** are **hardware devices** used to display outputs from the CPU.
 
• **Types of monitors:**
 
 
• **CRT (cathode ray tube)** monitors.
 
• **LCD (liquid crystal display)** monitors.
 
• **LED (light-emitting diodes)** monitors. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A keyboard is an **input device composed of buttons** used to **create letters, numbers, and symbols, and perform additional functions.**
 
• A **mouse is a handheld hardware** input device that **controls a cursor** in a **GUI (graphical user interface) **and can move and select the **text, icons, files, and folders on your computer.**
 
• A **scanner is a device** that **captures images** from **photographic prints, posters, magazine pages, and similar sources for computer editing and display.**
